claims: Dana White is the UFC CEO.
Dana White announced that 85,000 free tickets will be available for the UFC Freedom 250 event.
The UFC Freedom 250 event is scheduled for June 14, 2026.
The UFC Freedom 250 event will be held on the South Lawn of the White House and the surrounding Ellipse in Washington, D.C.
85,000 free tickets will be offered for the UFC Freedom 250 event.
Many tickets for the UFC Freedom 250 event are designated for military personnel.
The UFC Freedom 250 event is part of the U.S. 250th anniversary celebrations.
The UFC Freedom 250 event will feature a viewing experience on the Ellipse for the general public.
The fight for the UFC Freedom 250 event will occur on the South Lawn.
The fight card for the UFC Freedom 250 event tentatively features Justin Gaethje vs. Ilia Topuria for the lightweight title.
The fight card for the UFC Freedom 250 event tentatively features Alex Pereira vs. Ciryl Gane for the interim heavyweight title.
Details on how to register or obtain tickets for the UFC Freedom 250 event are to be announced.
As of early April 2026, these are plans announced by Dana White.
As of early April 2026, official booking links for the general public are not yet live.
